# Roleplay Rule 6 - Vigilantism / Validhunting
"Validhunting" is an out-of-character term that refers to when a crew-aligned character attempts to track down ("hunt") and kill an antagonist or otherwise "valid" entity to kill. You should not strive to validhunt other players.
Unless you have a good in-character roleplay reason to believe a global or round-ending threat exists, you should not act like a vigilante if a security force is present.
Antagonists that are not automatically global or round-ending threats may still become so through their actions in the shift. The stronger your reasoning, the more action you can take against them.
## Precedents
- You may [italic]always[/italic] defend both yourself and your department from antagonists or other threats, but as soon as said threat exits your department, it becomes strictly [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color]’s job to handle it. - The only exception to this rule would be to fight inherently station-ending threats [bold]after[/bold] an announcement ordering crew to arm.
